scope: Whole 6-symbol source-only safety/correctness review for this new MSVC AMD64 console executable only

findings.title: Select exact double overload before function-to-address cast
findings.reason: The selected MSVC cmath declares global float and long-double overloads for log1p/floor in addition to the C double declarations. reinterpret_cast<const void*>(&::log1p) and the analogous floor expression provide an object-pointer target, not the function-pointer signature required to select an overload. The source has not established a unique imported double function address and is not accepted for compile/run.
sourceEvidence: MSVC14.44.35207/include/cmath:124 float floor;186 float log1p;381 long-double floor;448 long-double log1p; global C++ overload region begins36
findings.correction: For each of log1p and floor, first static_cast to the exact double (__cdecl *)(double) function pointer, then reinterpret_cast that selected pointer to const void*. Keep other source behavior and narrow scope unchanged; repin the whole source and obtain fresh review before first compile/run.
findings.verifiedBy: Source/header inspection only; no compiler execution or claimed compiler diagnostic
